maria: Quick async standup — brief update for feature-gating + launch timing

maria: What I did: finished gating logic for model selection, landed server-side flag handling, updated docs + rollout plan PR.
maria: Blockers: need a UX sign-off on the gating flow (edge cases for fallbacks), and QA window to validate canary metrics.
maria: Today: request review for PR #432, confirm QA window (prefer tomorrow 10–11am PT), decide canary cadence (5% -> 25% -> 100%).

alex: saw the PR, leaving a couple of comments on the config schema. will try to review end of day.

sam: I can pick up the review first thing tomorrow if you need it fast, @alex — ping me on slack when ready.

ci-bot: build: failed — tests/regression/model_fallback_test.py on feature-gate branch. https://ci.internal/1234/logs

alex: ah build failure looks flaky, reproducing locally now. might be due to mock timing in that test.

taylor: UX note: for the fallback toast we should show a single-line explanation + link to settings, per the spec. added a small mock in Figma and left a comment on the PR.

chris: prioritization question — if QA finds a perf regression during canary, do we pause the rollout or degrade to the older model automatically? need to decide SLOs for rollback.

maria: plan is automatic fallback to the previous model + alert us, with an automatic pause if error rate > 3% for 5m. I'll add that to rollout config.

alex: pushed a small fix for the flaky test, CI triggered again.

ci-bot: build: success — all checks passed. https://ci.internal/1234/summary

sam: quick ask — can we get a QA test plan doc? I can draft smoke checks to run during tomorrow's window.

maria: yes please, @sam. add smoke checks for latency, correctness on the few known prompts, and error-rate thresholds. link it here when ready.

chris: for canary cadence, +1 to 5%->25%->100% but let's add an optional 60% step if the load is high. keeps risk low.

taylor: UX sign-off: approved the fallback toast and small copy tweak.

maria: thanks all — action items: @alex finish schema review, @sam draft QA plan, @chris finalize rollback thresholds, @taylor update Figma link in PR. aiming to start QA tomorrow 10am PT.

alex: noted, will finish tonight.

sam: drafting now, will post link in this thread by 9:30am PT tomorrow.

chris: will push rollback thresholds to the rollout config by EOD.

maria: great. if anyone hits blockers reply here — otherwise I'll mark this ready to ship pending QA. :rocket:
